title: MDX Condition
description: One diagnosable condition in the MDX knowledge base. One YAML file per condition in kb/conditions/.

urgency.description: How fast a Crew Medical Officer must act.

prior.description: Baseline probability this condition is present in a crewmember on a long-duration mission, before any findings. Used as the starting log-odds.

microgravity_note.description: Why this presents DIFFERENTLY in microgravity than on Earth. Required for anything the panel will ask about.

findings.description: Evidence that moves the score. Each entry references a finding id from kb/findings.yaml.

weight.description: Log-odds contribution when PRESENT. Positive = supports. Negative = argues against. +2.0 is strong, +0.5 is weak.

absent_weight.description: Log-odds contribution when explicitly ABSENT (denied). Defaults to 0 = unknown/absent tells us nothing.

required.description: If true and this finding is explicitly absent, the condition is ruled out entirely.

red_flags.description: If any of these findings are present, escalate immediately regardless of score.

recommend.description: What the CMO should do next. Actions, not prescriptions.

differential.description: Condition ids that look similar and must be ruled out.

sources.description: EVERY condition must cite a real source. No source, no rule.
